title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
abstract: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical graduate seminar on embodied artificial intelligence, today’s lecture is on RobotWorld. Recent work such as EmbodiedSWE and CaP-X explores coding agents that write programs to control robots or simulated tasks. RobotWorld asks a broader question: can abilities developed for using digital tools carry over across different kinds of robots? The shift is from demonstrating that an agent can act to measuring whether it completes varied tasks. That matters because a convincing episode can hide how often things go wrong. Noah, I see your hand—go ahead.
segments.zh: 在一场假设中的具身人工智能研究生讨论课上，今天的讲座主题是RobotWorld。最近像EmbodiedSWE和CaP-X这样的工作，探索的是编写程序来控制机器人或模拟任务的编程智能体。RobotWorld则提出了一个更宏观的问题：为使用数字工具而培养出来的能力，能否迁移到不同类型的机器人上？这一转变在于，从证明一个智能体能够行动，转向衡量它是否能完成各种各样的任务。这一点很重要，因为一段有说服力的演示片段，可能掩盖了事情实际上有多频繁地出错。Noah，我看到你举手了，请讲。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what does the opening robot demonstration actually show?
segments.zh: 教授您好，开头那个机器人演示到底说明了什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors describe a recording of Claude Opus 5.5 controlling a simulated drone in a one-on-one volleyball match and winning. In ordinary terms, the agent observes the situation, chooses drone actions, and gets feedback before acting again. The win is a concrete success in that episode, not evidence that the agent will reliably control robots across different tasks. The paper also retains a volleyball task record, but it is a separate episode from the recording.
segments.zh: 作者描述了一段Claude Opus 5.5控制模拟无人机进行一对一排球比赛并获胜的录像。通俗地说，就是智能体观察局势，选择无人机动作，拿到反馈后再进行下一次动作。这场胜利只是那个回合里的一个具体成功，并不能证明这个智能体能在不同任务中可靠地控制机器人。论文里也保留了一条排球任务的记录，但那是和录像分开的另一个回合。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the benchmark tests more than whether an agent can produce plausible motion?
segments.zh: 所以这个基准测试的不只是智能体能不能做出看起来合理的动作？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. RobotWorld collects 84 tasks from 20 source projects, covering manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control. Agents receive task instructions, permitted observations, and robot tools. They act in bounded segments, receive execution feedback, and can decide what to do next. Different tasks use different robot interfaces and levels of controller assistance, so the benchmark spans varied demands rather than holding every physical condition constant.
segments.zh: 确实如此。RobotWorld从20个源项目中收集了84个任务，涵盖操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶和空中控制。智能体接收任务指令、允许的观测和机器人工具。它们在有限的片段中行动，接收执行反馈，并可以决定下一步做什么。不同任务使用不同的机器人接口和不同程度的控制器辅助，因此这个基准涵盖的需求多种多样，而不是把每个物理条件都固定不变。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central result is modest completion across that breadth. G-P-T six Astra, the leading model, completed 16 of 84 tasks, or 19%. Claude Opus 5.5 completed 13 of 84, or 15.5%. The score is the fraction of tasks whose executable checker returned success at the applicable budget boundary. Every task counts equally; unfinished tasks count as failures, and partial reward is not averaged into the score.
segments.zh: 核心结果是在这么大的任务范围里，完成率并不高。GPT-6 Astra 是表现最好的模型，完成了 84 个任务中的 16 个，也就是 19%。Claude Opus 5.5 完成了 84 个中的 13 个，也就是 15.5%。得分是指在相应预算边界内，可执行检查器返回成功的任务比例。每个任务权重相同；未完成的任务算作失败，部分奖励不会平均计入得分。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: should we interpret those percentages as estimates of repeated-run reliability?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这些百分比是不是应该理解成对重复运行可靠性的估计？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. There was one evaluated episode for each model and task, so these figures describe outcomes in this evaluation, not performance across repeated trials. That distinction matters: a model might succeed or fail differently from another initial condition or another attempt. The study also runs entirely in simulation, and physics pauses while the model deliberates. The scores are useful for comparing these retained outcomes, but they do not establish real-time or real-robot reliability.
segments.zh: 不是。每个模型和任务只评估了一个回合，所以这些数字描述的是本次评估中的结果，而不是多次重复试验中的表现。这个区别很重要：换一个初始条件或再试一次，模型可能就会有不同的成败。这项研究还完全在仿真中运行，而且模型思考时物理引擎会暂停。这些分数适合用来比较这些保留下来的结果，但并不能证明实时或真实机器人上的可靠性。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A task’s executable checker, rather than the agent’s own declaration, determines whether it is complete. Depending on the task, success might require reaching a position with the right orientation, preserving an object’s state, making contact and releasing, sustaining a condition over time, or following events in order. Think of a checker as a finish-line judge: movement toward the finish is not enough if the task’s required conditions have not been met.
segments.zh: 任务是否完成，由该任务的可执行检查器来判定，而不是由智能体自己说了算。具体取决于任务，成功可能要求到达某个位置并且朝向正确、保持物体的状态、接触并松开、让某个条件持续一段时间，或者按顺序完成一系列事件。可以把检查器想象成终点线的裁判：如果没有满足任务要求的条件，光是朝终点移动是不够的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how the traces help explain the gap between motion and completion?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下这些轨迹如何帮助解释动作与完成之间的差距吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Consider the drone-juggling comparison. Both models performed offline calculations about the drone’s dynamics, and both used a median of three executed control steps per call. Yet Astra recorded three valid contacts, only one meeting the height qualification, before ending at step 188. Opus recorded 15 valid contacts, 14 height-qualified, by step 800. The checker required a contact and a ball arc above 3.5 meters, confirmed at a later valid contact.
segments.zh: 以无人机抛接这个对比为例。两个模型都离线计算了无人机的动力学，每次调用都用了三次实际执行控制步骤的中位数。但Astra在结束于第188步之前，只记录到三次有效接触，其中仅一次满足高度要求。Opus到第800步时记录了15次有效接触，其中14次满足高度要求。检查器要求一次接触以及一个高于3.5米的球弧线，并在之后的一次有效接触中得到确认。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That comparison suggests a difference in sustained contact coordination in those two episodes; it does not prove what caused the difference. The models’ strategies were not held constant in a controlled experiment. More broadly, the authors describe traces where agents built visual or physical-modeling workflows, but still failed to preserve an object, adapt after stalled progress, recover in time, or recognize that a goal remained unfinished. These examples explain possible failure mechanisms, not how frequently each occurs across all tasks.
segments.zh: 这个对比说明的是那两个轨迹在持续接触协调上存在差异，并不能证明差异的成因。两个模型的策略并没有在受控实验中保持不变。更广泛地说，作者描述了一些轨迹，其中智能体搭建了视觉或物理建模的工作流，但仍然没能保住物体、在进展停滞之后做出调整、及时恢复，或者意识到目标尚未完成。这些例子解释的是可能的失败机制，而不是每种机制在所有任务中出现的频率。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hold on, does that mean the paper identifies a specific ability that predicts success?
segments.zh: 等等，这是不是说这篇论文找到了某种能预测成功的特定能力？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not decisively. The authors’ interpretation is that perception and computation must connect to feedback-driven action: observe the relevant state, act, check the result, and adjust when necessary. But the benchmark does not isolate vision, coding, or control ability in separate experiments. It also uses a finite, uneven task suite, with only four aerial tasks. These findings can guide future tests and system design, but they should not be treated as evidence of a single proven recipe for reliable robots.
segments.zh: 不能算决定性证据。作者的解释是，感知和计算必须与反馈驱动的行动相连接：观察相关状态、采取行动、检查结果，必要时进行调整。但这个基准并没有在单独的实验中分离出视觉、编程或控制能力。它使用的任务集也有限且不均衡，其中空中任务只有四个。这些发现可以指导未来的测试和系统设计，但不应被视为某种单一且已被验证的可靠机器人方案的证据。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this broader evaluation compare with EmbodiedSWE and CaP-X?
segments.zh: 这种更广泛的评估和EmbodiedSWE、CaP-X相比怎么样？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They provide useful context, but their scores are not directly comparable. EmbodiedSWE reports 82% success for G-P-T six Astra on 28 long-horizon dexterous tasks, with full simulator-state access. CaP-X studies how programming interfaces, interaction, and visual grounding affect robot-manipulation coding agents. RobotWorld emphasizes a broader range of tasks and robot embodiments, alongside analysis of recorded trajectories. Different tasks and conditions mean these benchmarks do not show that one result is right and another is wrong.
segments.zh: 它们提供了有用的背景信息，但分数不能直接比较。EmbodiedSWE 报告称，G-P-T 六号 Astra 在 28 个长时程灵巧任务上成功率达到 82%，并且可以完全访问模拟器状态。CaP-X 研究编程接口、交互和视觉 grounding 如何影响机器人操作的编码智能体。RobotWorld 则强调更广泛的任务范围和机器人形态，同时对录制的轨迹进行分析。任务和条件不同，意味着这些基准并不能说明一个结果是对的、另一个是错的。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The lesson is that one successful match and broad task completion answer different questions. The volleyball win shows that an agent can complete that particular simulated activity; RobotWorld’s suite shows how much harder it is to complete a varied set of tasks. For robot use, progress depends on preserving task-relevant state, changing ineffective actions, meeting conditions that unfold over time, and checking completion rather than assuming it. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 关键在于，一次成功匹配和广泛的任务完成度回答的是不同的问题。排球比赛的胜利说明智能体能够完成那个特定的模拟活动；RobotWorld的测试套件则表明，完成一系列多样化任务的难度要大得多。对于机器人应用而言，进展取决于能否保留与任务相关的状态、改变无效动作、满足随时间展开的条件，以及核实任务是否完成，而不是想当然地认为已经完成。感谢收听。如果你还有任何问题，可以询问我们的AI助手，或者留下评论。
